G3579833.description: Victoria is a town and capital of Saint Mark Parish, the smallest parish in Grenada. It has a population of 2256 (2013), and is the fourth largest town in Grenada.

G3579837.description: Upper La Taste is a town in Saint Patrick Parish, Grenada. It is located towards the northern end of the island, along the eastern coast.

G3579854.description: Tivoli is a small village in the parish of St. Andrew, Grenada located in the northeast of the island.

G3579891.description: Sauteurs (pronounced Sau-tez) is a fishing town in the Saint Patrick Parish, Grenada and is the sixth-largest town on the island of Grenada, with a population of about 1,300. It is located in the far north of Grenada.

G3579925.description: St. George's (Grenadian Creole French: Sen Jòj) is the capital and largest city of Grenada.

G3580215.description: Hillsborough is the largest town (city) on the island of Carriacou, Grenada. The town serves primarily as a retail and administrative centre of both Carriacou and Petite Martinique.

G3580236.description: Grenville is the third largest town in Grenada, after St. George's and Gouyave and it is the capital of the largest parish, Saint Andrew.

G3580279.description: Gouyave (Gwouyav) is the capital and largest town in the parish of St John, Grenada. It is located on the west coast of the island of Grenada.
